description: The Customer Profiles actions as typed sub-blocks, each with its catch-all: get_customer_profile in both of its forms, profile_request_data an object holding identifier_name and identifier_value, and one holding search_criteria, a list of two objects, and logical_operator, each with its MultipleFoundError and NoneFoundError branches; create_customer_profile with profile_request_data a map of listed fields written unquoted (FirstName, PhoneNumber), the only request keys the service accepts (actions.md, rule 43), and profile_response_data a list holding a listed field and an Attributes.x name; update_customer_profile with a listed field and one Attributes.x response name; get_customer_profile_object with use_latest "true" and with identifier_name and identifier_value, each with profile_id and object_type, a NoneFoundError branch and response names from the page's list and an OrderAttributes.x pattern; get_calculated_attributes_for_customer_profile with a profile_id JSONPath, a predefined name from the page's list and a CalculatedAttributes.x pattern name, and its NoneFoundError branch; and associate_contact_to_customer_profile with profile_request_data an object of its two ids, each a JSONPath, and no profile_response_data, which the service refuses on it. No refs: the Customer Profiles domain is the instance's integration, not a parameter. Awaits the provider release that carries these blocks (tasks/D10), so it has no validate directory yet.
